findings.issue: Customer sync drops signer_name, signer_identity_number, method, ip_address and user_agent.
findings.proof: Direct local call of syncPowerOfAttorney with all five fields returns none of them.
findings.impact: This path cannot forward a complete signed/external-sendable POA; OPS documents draft/blocked delivery when evidence is missing. No live side effect tested.
findings.remediation: Preserve trusted original signing evidence with stable acceptance time/IP across retries; do not trust browser-supplied IP or BankID metadata.

findings.proof: Remove accepted from an otherwise normalizable synthetic input: actual normalizer returns accepted:true.
findings.impact: Outgoing sync payload can claim explicit acceptance absent from its input. This does not prove a successful external signature or delivery.
findings.remediation: Require explicit acceptance and return a field-level validation error for incomplete evidence.

findings.issue: Direct JSON reading omits the shared application byte limit, read deadline, MIME and origin checks.
findings.proof: Source inspection: direct req.json/request.json; no equivalent global proxy controls.
findings.impact: Application-level hardening coverage is incomplete; no CSRF exploit or bypass of platform request limits is claimed.
findings.remediation: Use the common bounded reader while preserving authentication and original operation keys.

findings.issue: Two published specifications changed descriptive signing/IP text under the same version.
findings.proof: Initial live drift check failed; manifest-verified sync and subsequent exact live check pass.

checks.detail: Description-only upstream changes; no path or validation-rule changes.

checks: Original IP and user agent preserved across repeated immutable submission
Website payload builder preserves original IP, time, user agent, consent method and exact textVersionId

pdf_verification_number.documentation_requires: Stable verification number on each page of the private accepted-text/scopes/evidence PDF; API server IP recorded separately.

false_positive_controls: Vercel documents x-forwarded-for as overwritten by default; helper mismatch alone does not prove spoofing.
The legacy local PDF generator has no caller found in app/lib/tests and is not the canonical Website PDF archive.
Description drift does not imply a breaking request-schema change.
